		<headline>Hangzhou Qiantang District Meteorological Observatory issues orange warning for heavy fog [Level II/Severe]</headline>
		<description>At 06:43 on October 31, 2026, the Qiantang District Meteorological Observatory in Hangzhou upgraded the yellow warning signal for heavy fog to an orange warning signal for heavy fog: It is expected that there will be heavy fog with visibility less than 200 meters in streets such as Yipeng, Xinwan, Qianjin, and Linjiang in our district from this morning to this morning. Relevant units and personnel are requested to be prepared for prevention. Drivers should pay attention to changes in heavy fog, drive carefully, and pay attention to traffic safety.</description>
		<instruction>The jurisdiction has entered an emergency defense state for heavy fog -1. Timely understanding of the latest meteorological information and defense notices for heavy fog, and reducing outdoor activities for residents; 2. Drivers should drive carefully; 3. Water facilities and personnel involved in water and underwater operations should immediately take safety measures or suspend their work activities. When visibility is less than 200 meters, ships should be driven cautiously or stopped; 4. Depending on the situation, stop outdoor collective activities, suspend classes, work, business, and other work. Please consult before heading to the airport and station.</instruction>
		<area>
			<areaDesc>Yipeng Street</areaDesc>
			<geocode>
				<valueName>CPEAS Geographic Code</valueName>
				<value>330114004000</value>
			</geocode>
		</area>
	</info>

		<description>杭州市钱塘区气象台2026年10月31日06时43分将大雾黄色预警信号升级为大雾橙色预警信号：预计今天早晨到上午我区义蓬、新湾、前进、临江等街道将出现能见度小于200米的浓雾，请有关单位和人员做好防范准备，驾驶人员注意浓雾变化，小心驾驶，注意交通安全。</description>
		<instruction>辖区进入大雾紧急防御状态—— 1.及时了解大雾最新气象信息和防御通知，居民减少户外活动； 2.驾驶人员小心驾驶； 3.水上设施、水上水下作业人员立即采取安全措施或者暂停作业活动，在出现能见度小于200米时，船舶应谨慎驾驶或者停航； 4.视情况停止户外集体活动、停课、停工、停业、停运等工作，前往机场和车站请先咨询。</instruction>
